tonight: Athens still. Lazy day in the city — alleys if we feel like it, nowhere we have to be.
tomorrow: More of Athens. Same easy pace.

postcard.title: Looking up
postcard.note: Julia and Daniel looking at the Parthenon. We forgot our chitons.
postcard.caption: Julia and Daniel looking at the Parthenon. We forgot our chitons. Twenty-four centuries, and it still does the looking-up.

word.meaning: Chiton — the ancient Greek tunic, usually white linen. We forgot ours at the Parthenon.
